title: Introduce KMS federation assertor and audit append-only proxy for tenant leases
author: Nina Park
release_notes: Adds a federated KMS assertion path and an append-only audit proxy; migration required for tenant operator lease tokens; no user-facing API breaking changes.
description: Context: Some enterprise customers run multiple key providers (customer-managed KMS in cloud regions, partner-managed HSMs, and on-prem vaults). We need a single service that can (1) determine a tenant's allowed KMS endpoints at request-time (federation/assertion), (2) enforce short-lived, operator-scoped KMS leases for cross-zone operations, and (3) record immutable audit metadata in an append-only proxy that prevents accidental or malicious audit rewrites. Motivation: Remove manual routing heuristics, reduce operator blast radius when KMS endpoints fail, and provide cryptographic provenance for audit events so compliance reviewers can trust the chain of custody. Summary of changes: 1) pkg/kms/federation: new KMS federation assertor that evaluates tenant-level KMS bindings, geo-affinity, and operator scopes to produce a per-request KMS target list and a lease token. 2) pkg/audit/appendonly: append-only audit proxy service that signs and sequences audit envelopes before forwarding them to the existing audit sink; implements dedupe-resistant sequence windows. 3) runtime/middleware/kms_hook.go: request-time hook to attach leased, ephemeral credentials and to annotate requests with signed provenance headers. 4) rbacv2/policy: small policy extension to allow operator-scoped temporary grants and to mark services that may request federated leases. 5) configs/kms/federation.yaml: configuration schema and example mapping for multi-provider federation and failover weights. 6) docs/security/kms-federation.md: design doc and migration notes. 7) tests/: integration coverage for lease issuance, audit append-only semantics, and policy grant resolution. Compatibility and rollout: the feature is behind a feature flag (feature.kms_federation=true) and a staged rollout toggle per-tenant. Default behavior for tenants not opted-in remains unchanged. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked and reviewed (docs/security/kms-federation.md) - [x] Unit tests for federation assertor (pkg/kms) - [x] Integration tests for audit proxy sequencing and sink compatibility - [x] Load testing with synthetic audit bursts to validate append-only latency and backpressure - [x] OPA policy test cases for operator-scoped grants - [x] Security review and threat model completed (SEC-902) - [x] Migration notes and rollback plan included in docs Risks & mitigations: - Race in sequence number assignment under high throughput -> mitigated by batching sequence reservations and backpressure (appendonly proxy uses CAS on seq shard). - Cross-provider auth failures -> federation assertor falls back to next candidate per failover weights and records telemetry for SRE. - Audit sink incompatibility -> append-only proxy supports passthrough mode and signed envelope compatibility layer. Testing: Added 48 unit tests, 6 integration tests (CI integration suite), and a local chaos experiment simulating provider outages. Performance: microbenchmark shows ~0.9ms median additional latency for requests that obtain a local lease token; global worst-case (cross-provider handshake) is ~35ms but is cached per-prefix for 30s. Migration and rollout steps: 1) Deploy append-only proxy in passive mode (sign-only) for 24h to collect telemetry. 2) Enable federation assertor for opt-in tenants (staged by percentage). 3) Flip to active append-only enforcement and operator-scoped grants after two successful days. Rollback: disable feature flag and invalidate active leases (leases expire in <= 5m by design). Monitoring & alerts: new SLI/SLO and dashboard (observability team) for lease issuance success rate, append-only backlog, and signed-envelope verification failures. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-4583 (federated KMS), SEC-902 (audit immutability).

review_comments: Omar Li: Can we tighten the default lease TTL to 2m for operators? 5m seems long for cross-operator operations. - addressed in a1b2c3d and noted in docs.
Priya Kapoor: Security scan flagged usage of rsa.SignPKCS1v15 in the proxy signer; prefer ed25519 for smaller envelopes. - replaced with ed25519 signer (b2c3d4e).
Diego Morales: Add an OPA policy mock for the shadow rollout so we can simulate deny/allow transitions. - added tests in pkg/opa and updated integration harness (g7b8c9d).
SRE (automated): Observability: please add histogram buckets for seq-latency >500ms. - added in observability dashboard commit.
QA: Integration test failure in CI on first run due to a fixture mismatch in audit sink - fixed in e5f6a7b.
merge_summary: Merged by Omar Li via squash on 2026-02-15. Squash commit: 'introduce kms federation assertor and append-only audit proxy (860214)'. Merge included 7 commits squashed into a single change. Post-merge tasks: created follow-up issue ENG-4583-2 to audit telemetry retention and to add per-tenant opt-out API.
notes_for_ops: Operations: to enable for a tenant set feature.kms_federation=true in tenant config and ensure tenant has at least one federation mapping in configs/kms/federation.yaml. Run 'redwoodctl lease purge --tenant <id>' to invalidate existing test leases during rollback. The append-only proxy requires a KMS signing key (ed25519) stored in secret manager; secret name pattern: 'kms-federation-proxy-signing-<env>'.
changelog_entry: Security: Add KMS federation assertor and append-only audit proxy to improve audit immutability and multi-provider KMS routing (opt-in feature).
notes: This PR was intentionally conservative about permissions: new rbac predicate 'can_request_federated_lease' defaults to false and must be granted explicitly. Performance regression risk evaluated and accepted based on bench results.
